purpose: Independent monitor/reviewer checks Subagent 1's fresh GitHub install and real-world WebLens runs.
rules: Do not use Tavily, paid APIs, or spend credits.
Use the isolated venv created by Subagent 1; do not use the primary .venv for the installed package.
Re-run at least one search and one extract to confirm the installed CLI works independently.
Do not treat a command that did not run as a pass.
Record exact commands, exit codes, timings, and raw outputs.

search.pass: at least 3 actual results with non-empty title, URL, and snippet; status ok
search.fail: 0 results, error, or only query echo

facts: page title or heading contains Example Domain
text contains a sentence about illustrative examples
extract_example_com.pass: all 3 facts supported by returned text

facts: page is about Python 3.14 (or the documented fallback 3.13)
at least 3 concrete feature/change terms are present
returned text is non-empty and has token/passage stats

map.pass: at least 1 URL, no duplicate URLs, status ok
map.partial: URLs returned but duplicates or partial status

crawl.pass: at least 1 page with text, status ok, page_failures reported
crawl.partial: page returned with failures or partial status

research.pass: at least 2 distinct sources/URLs and at least 2 claims traceable to those URLs
research.partial: sources returned but fewer than 2 claims are traceable
research.fail: no sources, prose-only answer, or error

accuracy_checks: For every claim, require a returned source URL; do not accept model prose alone.
Check example.com facts directly against the returned text.
Check Python docs facts against the returned page text and URL.
Count source URLs and claims exactly; do not infer.
Report PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL / BLOCKED / NOT RUN for each capability.
comparison_requirement: State that the GitHub install is a clean clone of commit b3a0b62; the primary working tree is dirty and contains uncommitted fixes. Do not attribute uncommitted fixes to the GitHub install.
